issue_title: 🎯 Prevent Goroutine and Ephemeral Consumer Leaks in `ObjectStore.Get` with Timeout-less Context during Server Unresponsiveness
issue_body_sample:
## 📝 Description
When calling `ObjectStore.Get` (or `ObjectStore.GetContext`) using a context without a configured timeout (such as `context.Background()`), the client can leak goroutines and ephemeral consumers if the NATS server becomes unresponsive or disconnects mid-operation.
